description: The graph illustrates the similarity scores across different layers for four distinct configurations—en&en (red), en&es (blue), en&el (green), and en&bn (purple)—in the context of a multilingual expansion for large language models. The x-axis, labeled "Layer," spans from 0 to 22, representing the layer index within the model architecture, while the y-axis, labeled "Similarity," ranges from 0.00 to 0.45, indicating the degree of similarity between representations. The red line (en&en) begins at a similarity of approximately 0.07 and shows a gradual increase to around 0.26 at layer 6, followed by a decline to about 0.10 at layer 20, before sharply rising to 0.44 at layer 23. The blue line (en&es) starts at roughly 0.06, peaks at 0.25 at layer 6, and then steadily decreases to about 0.05 at layer 20, rising slightly to 0.28 at layer 23. The green line (en&el) begins at approximately 0.05, increases to 0.24 at layer 6, and then declines to 0.05 at layer 20, before increasing to 0.30 at layer 23. The purple line (en&bn) starts at around 0.04, peaks at 0.24 at layer 6, and then decreases to about 0.05 at layer 20, rising to 0.30 at layer 23. All lines exhibit a general trend of increasing similarity up to layer 6, followed by a decline, and then a sharp increase towards the end of the model.
